title: Component styling
description: Angular components can include CSS styles that apply to that component's template.

blocks.text: This guide assumes you've already read the [Essentials Guide](essentials). Read that first if you're new to Angular.

Components can include CSS styles that apply to the component's DOM. You can define styles directly inside the `@Component` decorator using `styles`, or link external files using `styleUrl` or `styleUrls`:

By default, Angular scopes component styles using **Emulated View Encapsulation**. Angular preprocesses the component's CSS so that it only applies to elements in that component's template, mimicking Shadow DOM behavior without browser overhead.
